verdict.rationale: Cooley GO Docs offers online generators for real financing and formation documents: a Delaware incorporation package (certificate, bylaws, RSPA with IP assignment), YC Safe variants (US/UK/Singapore, free), and a Series Seed package. Conditional logic adds 83(b) and escrow documents when stock vests, and an independent HN user confirms these generators exist alongside static templates. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the interactive questionnaire flow and online completion experience, and a hands-on walkthrough confirming the end-to-end self-serve assembly.
